top_concerns: Text, main tables and appendix tables contradict each other in many cells; two of three analysed metric anomalies are artefacts (0.8117 vs 0.23; 0.4713 vs 0.1573).
All conclusions rest on an unvalidated GPT-5-mini judge: no quantified judge-human agreement in text, no ceiling, no second judge, self-preference risk.
Score denominators unstated (Molmo-7B-D: ER 4.55% yet highest CRD LMM-Score), single run, and tiny sub-settings (CRD n=36, CFD n=108).
Level 3 results are at floor, confounded by input-length limits, and cover only five proprietary models.
Positioning: unqualified 'first' claim, uncited Doc2Chart/Text2Chart31, 'user-driven' framing without user evidence, no data licence or contamination analysis.
notes: Literature check ran in strict mode (network available): 7 counted queries, 50 kept results, no high-overlap or text-overlap flags. integrity_scan.py was not run because the task limited tools to file reads and the aggregation script; I used a text search for reviewer-directed phrases instead and found none. Ambiguities: (1) the skill says the reviewers read a redacted copy, which was moot with no findings; (2) before_composite is ambiguous: before.json holds before_composite 51.0 (official composite) and an EIC composite of 50.8 (confidence-only), aggregate.json holds EIC composite 50.3; I reported 51.0 and 50.3. (3) The weighted rating 2.52 sits within 0.1 of the x.5 boundary and the composite is 0.3 above the band edge; the skill's departure rule handled it but the rating-vs-composite 'starting point' is fragile there. (4) The pool-position bands (typical rejected 42-54) and the Overall 3 vs 2 distinction are hard to apply to a paper with fixable but pervasive reporting errors. (5) Extraction garbled Fig. 2/3 text, so figure-dependent checks were hedged. (6) Running five roles in one context makes true independence impossible, as the skill discloses. (7) The ICLR label for final Overall 3 is printed as '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10} (5 on {1,3,5,6,8,10})', two scales at once.
